name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Hybrid.hardAt_chain
title: Hybrid chains: T hops of k bits give 2^k * gain <= T^2 * cost on the ends
statement: For laws D 0, ..., D T on words, if every hop (D i, D (i+1)) is a decision problem with k bits of strength (Problem.HardAt k: every machine has 2^k * squaredAdvantage <= cost), then every machine A distinguishing D 0 from D T has 2^k * gain <= T^2 * cost. A chain of 2^t hops loses 2t bits. This is the accounting for witness-indexed (exponential) hybrid arguments in post-quantum WE.
